# Strategy

What Quillmark is, what it makes and its parts are in [self.md](./self.md); this page says why it exists, who it serves and how it wins.

## Why it exists

Independent researchers lose their notes between tools. Quillmark keeps every note as plain text they own, and syncs it between their devices.

## Who it serves

Independent researchers who write long notes and want them to last.

## How it wins

- Notes stay plain text, where an alternative like Ledgerpad locks them in.
- Sync runs on Cloudberry Storage, so it must stay fast and cheap.
- Plugins such as Inkwell Plugins grow what it can do.
- It follows the Open Notes Format, shaped with its working group.
- It keeps to the data protection rules where its users live.
- Workshops at local libraries bring new writers.
- The Small Press Fair sponsors its yearly meetup.

## Values

- Plain text first: a plain-text note outlives the app it was written in.
- What lies outside it, its exterior, is read in daily visits, incidents, features and changes, never in a person's own data.
- Its app, its sync service and its plugin interface are its own; it controls its code, its releases and its pages.
